description: Test suite for the status store in Mattermost, including tests for saving, updating, retrieving, and expiring user status data.

methods.name: TestStatusStore
methods.description: Main test function executing various status store tests.

methods.name: testSaveOrUpdateMany
methods.description: Tests the SaveOrUpdateMany method with various scenarios including empty, single, multiple, and duplicate user IDs.

methods.name: testStatusStore
methods.description: Tests basic save, update, and retrieval of user statuses.

methods.name: testActiveUserCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of active users increases as statuses are added.

methods.name: testUpdateExpiredDNDStatuses
methods.description: Tests expiration of Do Not Disturb statuses after their end time.

methods.name: insertNullStatus
methods.description: Inserts a status record with NULL values for testing retrieval of null columns.

methods.name: testStatusGet
methods.description: Tests retrieval of status data, including null columns and specific statuses.

methods.name: testStatusGetByIds
methods.description: Tests batch retrieval of statuses by user IDs, including null and multiple statuses.
